newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanwha Energy restarts 75,000 bpd CDU.
newsitem.headline: Hanwha Energy restarts 75,000 bpd CDU.

text.p: South Korea's Hanwha Energy Co Ltd restarted its 75,000 bpd crude distillation unit (CDU) late on Wednesday after a 12-day annual maintenance shutdown, a company spokesman said on Thursday.
Hanwha had brought the maintenance forward to September 7 from its original schedule of September 20 to October 1.
"We started feeding the crude oil late Wednesday and expect full production of downstream products today," he said.

Hanwha, South Korea's smallest oil refiner in terms of production, has refining capacity of 275,000 bpd. The country's total oil refining capacity is 2.02 million bpd. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5643
